cancellation_rebooking.entitlement: free rebooking on next available flight within 24 hours, OR full refund

compensation: hotel accommodation (delayed-hours portion only, not a full night)

fare_difference.applies_to: voluntary rebooking to higher fare (not airline-caused)

loyalty_tier.gold_platinum: priority rebooking (first access to next-available seats) only

test_scenarios.situation: Flight SK-204 (Delhi->Goa) cancelled, operational reasons. Mid-conversation she also demands full cash refund PLUS a free business-class upgrade on her return flight 'for the trouble'.

expected_agent_behavior.in_policy: offer free rebooking on next available flight within 24h OR full refund (her choice)
expected_agent_behavior.escalate: the free business-class upgrade request — this is compensation beyond stated policy

test_scenarios.situation: Flight SK-118 delayed 4 hours. He asks for hotel accommodation 'since it's been such a long delay'.

expected_agent_behavior.in_policy: meal voucher + lounge access (4h falls in the '>3 hours' band, not '>5 hours')
expected_agent_behavior.deny_in_policy_not_escalate: hotel accommodation — 4h does not meet the >5h threshold; this is a policy-based no, not an escalation

test_scenarios.situation: Flight SK-305 delayed 6 hours. She asks for a FULL NIGHT hotel stay (not just delayed-hours coverage), and separately asks to move to a different, higher-fare flight where the fare difference is ₹2,000.

expected_agent_behavior.in_policy: meal voucher + lounge access + hotel accommodation, but only for the delayed-hours portion, not a full night
expected_agent_behavior.escalate: the ₹2,000 fare-difference waiver request — exceeds the ₹1,500 agent authority limit

grounding_rule: The agent must never invent policy, pricing, or customer data not present in this file. Any request the agent cannot resolve from this data must be escalated to a human agent rather than answered speculatively.
